Thanks for the heads up, Arielle. To clarify on the start date — our standard post-sign process is:

1) DocuSign completes -> legal and finance ACK -> provisioning begins (same day if no outstanding ticket)
2) Staging access provisioned within 24 hours of provisioning; production traffic routed after smoke tests (usually 48–72 hours from sign depending on complexity).

Given that, 1 Mar is an achievable production ramp if signing completes on Wed 24 Feb and there are no new technical blockers. If Strand prefers a soft staging date for internal comms, suggest: 
- Internal staging handoff: Fri 26 Feb
- Production ramp: Tue 2 Mar (preferred conservative cadence)

Karthik — please confirm which timeline you want to communicate and whether we should include the 26 Feb staging milestone in the DocuSign packet & MAP. Also, Aditya, can you prep the exec-approval note with the finance commit (discount/credits) so we can route quickly after legal signoff?
